name: super-harness
description: Parallel sprint dispatcher on top of harness-zh: one git worktree + one headless claude worker per story, dependency-aware scheduling with a fixed number of slots, serial merge queue that auto-resolves ledger conflicts, and a board that only shows what needs a person. Provides /super-harness:init, /super-harness:run, /super-harness:board. Requires harness-zh >= 0.2.1 deployed in the project.
